prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Pearland, Texas. Injury: concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1489; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in Pearland, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. The impact threw me against the door and my head hit the window frame. I was dazed afterward and was taken to be checked out, where I was diagnosed with a concussion. I have described the events the same way to the officer at the scene, to the medical staff, and to everyone I have spoken with since, and I have nothing to add or change. I am the named driver on this policy and I am submitting this statement to support my claim for the injuries and damage resulting from the collision. I am still experiencing headaches and sensitivity to light, and I am following my doctor's instructions for recovery.
